Next Prerelease: Ashes of the Empire

Swing by your local game store starting on July 10th, 2026 for the Ashes of the Empire Prerelease event! Come hang out with your friends and try out the new cards in this simple, casual sealed tournament.

Need help finding an event? Check out the Store and Event Locator, linked below!

Competitive Play

Each set brings a new wave of Competitive events. With over 500 events happening each year, there’s ample opportunity for you to show of your tournament skills!
